So excited for this. That said I'm still a little cautious after how the hobbit turned out. Not that it was bad, but it was nowhere near the original trilogy. I expect this to be better than the prequel trilogy, but I'd be surprised if it was better than the original three.

For starters there is no doubt this trilogy will be different from the other two we've seen already. That's a given just from the fact that they have a different director. Due to this there will inevitably be hate from fans because there was not enough light sabers or too much lens flare or too many people. I don't think anyone can compare this to the original trilogy, because it is simply not a fair comparison. Lucas and Abrams have their different styles. Abrams will almost certainly do something with the canon that people will hate, like he did with Star Trek. I'm not saying this is good or bad, simply that it will happen when you have someone new take over. The first Star Wars came out in 1977, 38 years ago. Since then film making has changed drastically, even since the prequels were released there have been some amazing developments and these new advancements will almost certainly produce a new trilogy that feels and plays differently from the others. With all this in mind I plan to watch these films where I will be familiar with the Universe, but it will be displayed to me in a way I've never seen it before, and I'm excited for that.

IMO The Hobbit trilogy is bad. There were too many absurdities that took away from the films. Also Legolas.

I have my fears too, but JJ Abrams does some very good work when he is fully engaged. The problems arise when he starts something then hands it over to someone else and just oversees it (Alias for example).

I really think this movie will be the redemption we've been waiting for since EP1. Really hope I'm not wrong!
Glad JJ Abrams is doing it. He is honestly the best person for the job. However Im still a little sad he left the Star Trek franchise
